faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.subtitle: Direct answers regarding our templates, customization process, and studio engineering.

items.question: Can you customize any Framer template?
items.answer: Yes. We adapt and customize any official Framer marketplace template or third-party theme—adjusting brand palettes, typography, custom CMS fields, and third-party integrations.

items.question: What is the typical turnaround time?
items.answer: Template customizations are completed in 3 to 5 business days. Custom website builds take 2 to 3 weeks depending on scope.

items.question: How do you optimize Framer site speed?
items.answer: We eliminate render-blocking fonts, compress assets to AVIF/WebP, and streamline responsive breakpoint trees to consistently achieve 95+ scores on Google PageSpeed Insights.

items.question: How do we get started?
items.answer: Email your project brief directly to sparkstudio0@outlook.com. We review your requirements and respond within 24 hours with a fixed quote and start date.
